description: MailBackend::update_object is documented to return Some(O) when the backend wants to report server-set properties after a patch. Every handler discards the return value with Ok(_) or Ok(Some(_)). A backend implementor who returns Some(O) to signal server-modified fields will be surprised to find the response is unchanged — their updated object is silently dropped. This is a silent API contract violation. Either: (a) document clearly in every handler that the return value is ignored, or (b) use the returned object to populate the 'updated' response map when Some.
title: update_object Option<O> return value silently discarded in all handlers
